issue_body: We need a small helper that guest programs can call to spell an integer out in words. Please add a callable named tbx.NumToWords with signature NumToWords(n int) string that converts an integer in the range 0..9999 into its lowercase English-words form.
expected_behavior: Guest programs can import "tbx" and call tbx.NumToWords(n) to spell an integer in 0..9999 out in lowercase English words.
skills_tested: teens as unique words rather than ten-plus-units
hyphenation between tens and units words
composing words with single spaces and no "and"
handling exact multiples and out-of-range inputs
discovering and registering a stdlib callable
